author: Joshua Fluke
description:
Your resume may be the reason you’re not getting interviews — and one of the biggest mistakes job seekers make is giving employers way too much information.
In this video, I’m roasting real resumes and showing you the resume red flags, ATS mistakes, formatting problems, useless skills, unnecessary sections and personal information that can quietly hurt your chances of getting a callback.

We’re covering everything from freelancing and side hustles to overlapping jobs, hobbies and interests, references, soft-skill buzzwords, technical skills, professional summaries, ATS formatting, tables, years of experience, graduation dates, age, metrics, bullet points and how much work history you should actually include.
Because the goal of a resume isn’t to tell an employer everything about your life.
It’s to get the interview.

title: YOUR RESUME IS TELLING EMPLOYERS WAY TOO MUCH!
